ask.title: Leave the game?
ask.body: This match ends. Your game is not saved.

ask.title: Leave the game?
ask.body: You will drop out. Your ants are lost, the others play on, and you cannot come back to this match.

ask.title: Forfeit and leave?
ask.body: You give up this match. It ends now for everybody and counts as a loss for you.

ask.title: Leave the game?
ask.body: The match is held. You leave it for good and cannot come back to this match.
